resources.string: Or connect the whole computer, with no proxy settings
Every application on the computer, DNS and UDP included, goes through this device, and through this device\'s VPN if it has one. The computer needs sing-box (free, installed once) and one command.
On the computer, open this address in a web browser. It shows the exact command for Linux, macOS or Windows:
Start the %1$s Hotspot to see the address.
SOCKS is turned off, and this needs it. With the Hotspot stopped, turn on the SOCKS4A/SOCKS5H Proxy switch under Proxy Mode in the Hotspot tab, then start the Hotspot.
Idle connections such as SSH are closed after the Socket Timeout. In the Behavior tab, use Adjust Socket Timeout to set 5 minutes or No Timeout.
To share this device\'s VPN, the VPN must allow local network access, and %1$s must not be excluded from it.
